purpose: Preserve county-specific negative-evidence reviews for comparison candidates without turning an incomplete or bounded search into a claim that a project never existed.
decision_rule: A county may be labeled eligible_verified_no_known_project only when all seven required domains are documented as reviewed_no_qualifying_evidence through the dataset as-of date, the review is final, and no governed positive-exposure finding applies. Partial reviews remain unresolved; positive evidence must also be recorded in the exposure-findings register.
